steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Erosion is the removal and transport of weathered material by rivers, wind, ice and gravity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: River erosion processes: hydraulic action (force of water), abrasion (sediment scraping bedrock), attrition (particles rounding), solution (dissolving)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Transport methods: traction (rolling large particles), saltation (bouncing), suspension (fine particles carried in water), solution (dissolved load)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Deposition occurs when the transporting agent loses energy: river slows (inside of meander, floodplain), glacier melts, wind drops

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Name the four processes of river erosion. | Q: Describe the four methods of sediment transport by rivers. | Q: What causes deposition to occur?

Solution: dissolved minerals carried invisibly | Deposition occurs when the transporting agent (river, wind, ice) loses energy and can no longer carry its sediment load. steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Four erosion processes: hydraulic action, abrasion, attrition, solution Four transport methods: traction, saltation, suspension, solution Deposition = loss of energy (velocity, gradient, volume decrease) Glacial: plucking and abrasion; River: hydraulic action and abrasion
